mapper.select:
select tu.id, tu.avatar, tu.nick_name, tu.birth_date, tu.height, tu.education,us.status, us.id as auditId, us.apply_read_status as readStatus, us.apply_desc as applyDesc, tu.lately_time, tu.create_time, tu.city, tu.id_auth, tu.sex
,CASE WHEN tu.lon IS NOT NULL AND tu.lat IS NOT NULL THEN ST_Distance_Sphere( POINT(#{lon}, #{lat}), POINT(tu.lon, tu.lat) ) ELSE NULL END AS distance
from user_apply us left join t_user tu on us.user_id = tu.id
us.del_flag = 0 and tu.del_flag = 0
and us.apply_user_id=#{ownerId}
order by us.create_time,us.id asc

select tu.id, tu.avatar, tu.nick_name, tu.birth_date, tu.height, tu.education,us.status, us.id as auditId,us.apply_wait_status as readStatus,us.apply_read_status as otherReadStatus, tu.lately_time, tu.create_time, tu.city, tu.id_auth, tu.sex
,CASE WHEN tu.lon IS NOT NULL AND tu.lat IS NOT NULL THEN ST_Distance_Sphere( POINT(#{lon}, #{lat}), POINT(tu.lon, tu.lat) ) ELSE NULL END AS distance
from user_apply us left join t_user tu on us.apply_user_id = tu.id
us.del_flag = 0 and tu.del_flag = 0 and (us.status = '2' or us.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 2 WEEK))
and us.user_id=#{ownerId}
order by us.create_time desc

select count(1) from user_apply us left join t_user tu on us.user_id = tu.id where us.del_flag = 0 and tu.del_flag = 0 and tu.id is not null and us.status = '2' and us.apply_read_status = '0' and us.apply_user_id = #{id}

select count(1) from user_apply us left join t_user tu on us.apply_user_id = tu.id where us.del_flag = 0 and tu.del_flag = 0 and tu.id is not null and us.status = '2' and us.apply_wait_status = '0' and us.user_id = #{id}
mapper.update: update user_apply us set us.`status`='3' where us.status = '1' and us.create_time <DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 10 DAY)
mapper.select: select ua.id from user_apply ua where ua.del_flag=0 and ua.`status`='1' and ua.create_time<=DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) order by ua.create_time asc,ua.id asc
